newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault rolls out its millionth Twingo.
newsitem.headline: Renault rolls out its millionth Twingo.

text.p: French carmaker Renault said on Thursday that it had rolled out one million Twingos -- those quirky minicars that jazzed up the economy segment.
The millionth model was assembled last Thursday in the Flins factory in Normandy that has built Twingos since the launch in 1993. It was given to an employee who won an in-house lottery.
The peppy minicar with the rounded lines and cartoonish headlamps is also produced in Spain, Colombia and even Taiwan. It features regularly among the top 20 bestsellers in Europe.

"A fine performance for a car which comes in only one body style and one engine," Renault said in a statement celebrating the production milestone of the model that revived its reputation as a design trend-setter.
That reputation was driven home by the smash hit more recently of the innovative Megane Scenic, a car proportioned like a minivan that has set Renault's competitors scrambling to roll out imitations.
